parameter_status: Document-based 25T with literature-derived 3D lateral/hunting parameters; HHT integration; not experimentally validated

assumptions.speed: 120 km/h scenario assumption; no operating speed specified in source document
assumptions.support: Legacy linear bilateral equivalent axle support, not Hertz contact
assumptions.track: Synthetic windowed sinusoid retained for comparison; no measured irregularity in this file
assumptions.dampers: Two per axle / two per bogie; odd symmetry, origin added, linear interpolation and last-segment extrapolation
assumptions.damper_joints: Source joint stiffnesses recorded but not modeled
assumptions.model_extension: 27 spatial DOFs (carbody+2 bogies: z+pitch+y+roll+yaw; 4 wheelsets: z+y+yaw). Kalker linear creep on lateral and spin channels, conicity-based gravitational restoring, anti-hunting yaw damper at secondary stage, anti-roll bar at secondary stage, anti-pitch link. HHT integrator with alpha=-0.05 numerical damping.
assumptions.inertias: Diagonal inertia tensors; carbody uses mass*half_bogie_spacing^2/12 Iyy and cylinder-like Ixx/Izz; bogie uses mass*(wheelbase/2)^2/12 Iyy; wheelset uses m*r^2/2 spin and r^2/4 pitch/yaw. Off-diagonal products set to zero. Override through model_3d.*_inertia_kg_m2 arrays when document values are confirmed.
assumptions.lateral_suspension: Primary lateral stiffness 13 MN/m per axle (2x6.5 MN/m axleboxes), secondary 0.36 MN/m per bogie (2x0.18 MN/m air springs); values adapted from 25T-type passenger-car literature.
assumptions.creep: Kalker linear coefficients f22=5.5 MN, f11=10 MN, f33=0.6 MN*m; equivalent conicity 0.05 (LM tread); lateral contact stiffness 80 MN/m. These are illustrative linearisation values, not derived from the source document.
assumptions.curve_following: track_curvature_1_m and track_cant_rad in model_3d enable quasi-static curving; default zero means straight track.

reference_only_not_used.inertia_note: Source says carbody parameter origin is at car center on rail plane; not used as-is in the 3D model.
